shape.sharp: radius 0 everywhere; edges do the work
shape.pill-controls: controls/tags fully pill-shaped, structure square or lightly rounded — contrast between the two
shape.tiered: radius tied to size tier: 4px small, 12px medium, 28px large; outer = inner + padding when nested
shape.organic: blobby/asymmetric border-radius (e.g. 62% 38% 46% 54% / 50% 40% 60% 50%) on images and accent shapes
shape.chamfered: cut corners via clip-path polygon (8–16px) — HUD/industrial
shape.arched: arch-topped images and panels (border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0) as the signature shape

edge.none: no borders; separation by space and tone
edge.hairline: 1px borders in border token; tables and dividers
edge.thick-ink: 2–4px solid text-colored borders on cards, buttons, images
edge.double: double rules (border-style: double 4–6px) — period print feel
edge.dashed: dashed/dotted rules as a motif (coupons, blueprints, forms)
edge.inset-frame: a frame inset from the viewport/card edge (outline + outline-offset) like a mat around a print

elevation.tonal: depth only from surface/surface-2 lightness steps
elevation.soft-layered: two-part shadow: tight dark + wide soft, low opacity, one light source
elevation.hard-offset: solid offset shadow (4–8px, no blur) in ink or an accent color
elevation.emboss: inner highlight + inner shadow; tactile buttons
elevation.glow: colored glow (box-shadow with accent at 30–50% alpha) — use on 1–2 elements only
elevation.paper-stack: slightly rotated stacked sheets with soft shadow

texture.grain: SVG feTurbulence noise at 4–8% opacity over backgrounds
texture.halftone: radial-gradient dot screen on images or color fields
texture.paper: warm fiber/noise + very slight vignette — printed matter
texture.mesh-gradient: multi-stop blurred color mesh — confined to one hero object, never the whole page
texture.riso-misregister: duplicated shapes/type offset 2–4px in a second ink with mix-blend-mode: multiply
texture.noise-gradient: smooth gradient with grain to prevent banding

hero.split-asymmetric: 7/5 or 8/4 split: copy one side, real product/visual the other
hero.poster-type: headline set enormous (clamp to ~12–18vw), image secondary or absent
hero.centered-statement: one centered statement + one action; only when the message is a single strong line
hero.full-bleed-image: edge-to-edge photograph/illustration; copy in a calm area or a solid caption block
hero.editorial-cover: magazine cover: masthead, issue line, cover lines arranged around one image
hero.bento-hero: hero as a bento of 3–5 tiles each showing a real facet
hero.product-demo: live or animated product UI as the hero, copy compact above/left
hero.split-screen: two full-height halves with contrasting grounds (color/photo vs text)
hero.index-list: hero is a large typographic index/list of work/items with hover previews
hero.horizontal-scroll: hero is a horizontally scrolling strip of items
hero.collage: overlapping cutouts, scraps and type layered with deliberate rotation
hero.kinetic-marquee: moving type band(s) as the hero signature (respect reduced motion)
hero.interactive-object: one manipulable object (slider, dial, configurator, toy) is the hero
hero.data-wall: dense live-looking numbers/charts as the opening statement
hero.letter-intro: opens like a letter/manifesto: a few paragraphs of large text, no visual

grid.asymmetric-12: 12-col with uneven spans (5/7, 4/8, 3/9) and deliberate empty columns
grid.modular: square/rectangular modules with strict gutters; content snaps to modules
grid.editorial-margins: main column + side margin for notes, captions, pull quotes
grid.bento: irregular tile grid (grid-auto-flow: dense) of varied spans
grid.broken-overlap: elements deliberately overlap across grid lines (negative margins, grid-area overlap)
grid.swiss-hangline: content hangs from a common top line; flush-left columns, large left margin
grid.alternating-bands: full-width bands alternating ground colors; content contained inside
grid.horizontal: sections arranged horizontally (scroll-snap) — use for portfolios/catalogs

motif.none: no motif; type and space only

imagery.duotone-photo: photos mapped to two palette colors

icons.geometric-glyph: simple geometric glyphs/symbols instead of icons

motion.still: no ambient motion; only state feedback

density.airy: big whitespace, few items per view

align.mixed-deliberate: a clear, repeated mix (e.g. headings centered on a stage, body flush-left in columns)
align.justified-blocks: justified text blocks with hyphens: auto (print feel; needs good hyphenation and lang attr)

color_use.duotone: two inks; overprint where they meet
color_use.inverted-bands: alternating light and dark sections from the two variants
color_use.full-ground: saturated ground color as the page (color-mode palette)
